subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: What permanent pagination contract should OpenClaw expose for message actions now that the display-limit bug is fixed?
rationale: The remaining request crosses CLI UX, plugin action payload shape, and provider-specific pagination semantics; automation can implement the chosen contract but should not invent the public page token shape or close the issue as fully fixed.

options.title: Define a shared page-token contract
options.body: Add a documented `pageToken` or cursor result/request shape for message read, pins, search, and channel-list, then implement provider adapters under that contract.

options.title: Narrow to Discord search first
options.body: Treat Discord offset pagination as the next focused fix and leave broader cross-provider cursor semantics for a separate design issue.

options.title: Stop at pagination hints
options.body: Close the remaining work as out of scope and keep only the merged display-limit and hint behavior as the supported contract.

recommendation.title: Define a shared page-token contract
recommendation.body: Add a documented `pageToken` or cursor result/request shape for message read, pins, search, and channel-list, then implement provider adapters under that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This account made the latest maintainer comment reopening the issue after the partial fix and is tied to release/current-behavior routing evidence.
